items.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010
items.q: I think one time we played up there and Big Nick was the guest, and Joe Newman.

ctx.x: Isn’t that something, the Rainbow Room. We were probably up there for maybe sometimes we’d be up there maybe three or four or five weeks at a time. And Duke Ellington would come by because Joe loved Duke, you know. Duke loved to sing with

the maestro and I’d tell him go ahead and play something, he’d play. Jimmy Jones would come by. Because Joe loved Jimmy Jones. And he’d always tell me, he would say, you know, not necessarily play like Jimmy Jones but listen. Which I had no problem with that because Jimmy Jones and Jerome Richardson were the ones that recommended me for the job with Joe Williams, you know. But yeah, isn’t that something. I think one time we played up there and Big Nick was the guest, and Joe Newman.
